title: Joe Oliver's failing band and Burton's advice to Armstrong
summary: In late 1920s New York he saw Oliver go broke promoting a band; he had urged Armstrong to leave Oliver.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline
